title: Ha Long overnight
summary: Sleep on a boat in the bay and go ashore where that boat lands. A published overnight average is 600,000–800,000 đồng a person, and that line does not name a boat or what the ticket includes.

days.title: Day 1 — Leave the harbor
days.body: Leave from the Ha Long passenger port or from Tuan Chau and sleep on the boat. Day boats return to the harbor. This one does not.

days.title: Day 2 — Ashore, then back
days.body: Go ashore where the boat lands. Sung Sot is on the longer route. Ti Top, Luon, and Trong Mai are the other landings named with it. Then return to the harbor.

stops.name: Sung Sot
stops.note: The longer route goes ashore here. Day-boat route 2 clocks Ti Top, Sung Sot, and Luon together at 5–6 hours. That clock is the day boat, not this overnight.

stops.name: Ti Top
stops.note: A landing on the longer route, if this boat stops.

stops.name: Luon
stops.note: Kayak or a rowboat on the longer route, if this boat stops.

stops.name: Trong Mai
stops.note: Seen from the deck, inside the route.

additions.name: Thien Cung
additions.note: Route 1, a different boat, clocked at 3–4 hours with Dau Go. Not this overnight.

additions.name: Dau Go
additions.note: The other cave on route 1, with Thien Cung.

seoDescription: Two days on Ha Long: sleep on the boat, and go ashore where that boat lands. The overnight average does not name a boat.
